我在这个工作流程上做了很多工作，以生成令人惊叹且稳定的图像。我完善了它，它包括品种。你可以支持我，你可以给我买杯咖啡。我很感激，因为我喝了很多咖啡😂☕

生成过程从左到右进行：

  • 一开始有一个Lora Stack，你可以用它来添加多个Loras。

  • 我添加了高效加载器，以出于同一目的摆脱多个节点。一切都合而为一。

  • 它全部连接到第一个 KSampler 来生成图像。

  • 然后连接到第二个KSampler；连接到 HiResFix 以进行放大和修复失真。

  • 然后它连接到 Ultimate SD Upscaler，但升级较低：(x1.25) 为了坚持原来的。

  • 此过程针对 3 个 Ultimate SD Upscaler 进行。因为使用像 (x2) 这样的大值会改变图像，有时会使图像扭曲很多。

  • 然后，最后一个 Ultimate SD Upscaler 连接到 Face Detailer。这将身体/人固定在一起。

  • 连接到第二个面部细节器以修复面部。

  • 最后连接到第三个面部细节器以固定手部。

  • 您可以将第二个 KSampler 的图像输出连接到图像对比度自适应锐化（图像锐化），然后从那里连接到 Ultimate SD Upscaler 的图像输入。您也可以对上传图像执行此操作。但是当心！图像锐化使图像看起来像绘画。

🔥重要注意事项!!🔥

使用控制网：

Efficient Loader 下面是 Control Net 的流程，也可以查看我的视频。

使用时，您只需将 Efficient Loader 的 Conditioning + 连接到 Apply Control Net 的 Posivite 输入即可。和条件 - 应用控制网络的负输入。然后将Apply Control Net 的正输出和负输出连接到第一个KSampler。

所以从某种意义上说；正向和负向将通过应用控制网连接。就这样。

使用附加功能： 图像等级：

您只需将 Latent Blend 的潜在输出连接到第一个 KSampler 的潜在图像输入。

但要查看其效果，请将第一个 KSampler 的降噪降低到 0.80 或 0.85 或可能 0.90

使用附加功能：图像控制：

您只需将 VAE Encode 的潜在输出连接到第一个 KSampler 的潜在图像输入。

但要查看其效果，请将第一个 KSampler 的降噪降低到 0.80 或 0.85 或可能 0.90

如果您的图像在 Ultimate SD Upscaler 中损坏：

如果您喜欢 HiResFix 中的图像结果，但 Ultimate SD Upscaler 扭曲了它，您可以再试一次。执行以下操作：

1-从 HiResFix 下载结果图像（第二次预览）

2- 将图像上传到 KSampler 上的加载图像。

3- 绕过 2 KSampler 和 HiResFix。

4- 将加载图像的图像输出连接到 Ultimate SD Upscaler 的图像输入。

  • 不要让注释让您感到困惑。我把它们展示给你和我自己；做什么做什么。

  • 对于 HiResFix，使用 4x Ultra Sharp 而不是 8x NMKD Superscale。因为这立即使图像变得如此之大。但对于 Ultimate SD Upscaler，您可以使用 8x NMKD Superscale，没有问题，或者使图像比预期更大。所以这种意外结果只发生在 HiResFix 中。

  • 使用 3 个不同的 Ultimate SD Upscaler 来放大图像解决了这个问题，其中仅使用 1 个 Ultimate SD Upscaler 和 x2 会导致图像扭曲。

  • First Face Detailer 正在修复身体，您会看到它修复了升级过程中发生的错误。人物/身体面部细节器还可以修复生成图像的面部。

  • 我决定将“Face”、“Face Detailer”放在“Hand”版本之前，因为有时“Hand”版本会造成混乱。所以Face版本的美丽修复不会浪费。

I worked on this workflow so much, to generate amazing and stable images. I perfected it, and it includes varieties.You can support me, you can Buy Me A Coffee.I'd appreciate that, because I drink a lot of coffees 😂☕

The generation process happens from left to right:

  • In the beginning there's a Lora Stack, you can use it to add multiple Loras.

  • I added Efficient Loader, to get rid of multiple nodes for the same purpose. It's all in one.

  • It's all connects to the first KSampler to generate Image.

  • Then connects to second KSampler; connected to a HiResFix for both upscaling and fixing distortions.

  • Then it's connected to an Ultimate SD Upscaler, but with low upscaling: (x1.25) In order to stick to the original.

  • This process goes on for 3 Ultimate SD Upscalers. Because using a big value like (x2) changes and sometimes distorts images a lot.

  • Then, the last Ultimate SD Upscaler connects to a Face Detailer. Which is fixing the body/person all together.

  • Connected to a second Face Detailer for fixing the Face.

  • Lastly connects to a third Face Detailer for fixing the Hands.

  • You can connect Image Output from second KSampler to Image Contrast Adaptive Sharpening (Image Sharpening) then from there to Image Input of Ultimate SD Upscaler. You can also do this for Upload Image. ButBEWARE!!Image Sharpening causes the images to look like paintings.

🔥Important Notes!!🔥

To Use Control Net:

Below the Efficient Loader stands the process for Control Net, check my video as well.

To use it, you just need to connect Efficient Loader's Conditioning + to Posivite Input of Apply Control Net. And Conditioning - to Negative Input of Apply Control Net. Then connect Positive and Negative Outputs of Apply Control Net to the first KSampler.

So in a sense; Positive and Negative will connect through the Apply Control Net. That's all.

To Use Extras: Image Grade:

You just need to connect Latent Blend's Latent Output to the first KSampler's Latent Image Input.

But to see it's effect, lower the Denoise of the first KSampler to 0.80 or 0.85 or maybe 0.90

To Use Extras: Image Control:

You just need to connect VAE Encode's Latent Output to the first KSampler's Latent Image Input.

But to see it's effect, lower the Denoise of the first KSampler to 0.80 or 0.85 or maybe 0.90

In a case that your image is broken in Ultimate SD Upscaler:

If you liked your image result in HiResFix but the Ultimate SD Upscaler distorted it, you can try it again. Do the following:

1- Download the result image from HiResFix (The Second Preview)

2- Upload the image to the Load Image over the KSamplers.

3- Bypass the 2 KSamplers and HiResFix.

4- Connect the Load Image's Image Output to the Ultimate SD Upscaler's Image Input.

  • Don't let the notes confuse you. I put them to show you and myself; what does what.

  • Use 4x Ultra Sharp instead of 8x NMKD Superscale for HiResFix. Because this immediately makes the image so big. But for the Ultimate SD Upscaler, you can use 8x NMKD Superscale, there's no problem, or making to image bigger than intented. So this unintended result happens only in HiResFix.

  • Using 3 different Ultimate SD Upscaler to upscaling the Image fixed the issue, where using just 1 Ultimate SD Upscaler with x2 was causing image to distort.

  • First Face Detailer is fixing the body, you'll see that it fixed mistakes happening on the Upscaling processes. Person/Body Face Detailer fixes the face of the generated image as well.

  • I decided to put Face, Face Detailer before the Hand version, because sometimes the Hand version is causing a mess. So the beautiful fix of the Face version wouldn't go to waste.
